name: Ring of Efreeti Calling
body:
Aura strong conjuration; CL 17th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of djinni calling. It serves as a special gate through which an efreeti can be called from the Plane of Fire.

When the ring is rubbed (a standard action), the call goes out, and the efreeti appears on the next round. The efreeti faithfully obeys and serves the wearer of the ring, but never for more than 1 hour. If the task assigned to the efreeti has not been completed within the 1 hour window, the efreeti will leave the task incomplete.

Once the hour passes, the efreeti turns upon the wearer, attacking without mercy until the ring to which it is bound is in its possession. If the wearer willingly surrenders the ring, he gains a +5 to Diplomacy checks to keep the efreeti from continuing the assault; a summoned efreeti’s beginning attitude is hostile.

The ring can be removed freely. If done so in an attempt to escape the effreeti while it carries out its assigned task, the effreeti will reclaim the ring and hunt down the former wearer. If the effreeti of the ring is killed, the ring becomes non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of djinni calling

Identification DC 42
False Identification DC 32
